title: KHR_animation_layers Mask
description: A skeletal mask that restricts which nodes a layer affects.

nodes.description: Array of node indices affected by this mask. Each index must be unique.

weights.description: Parallel array of weights [0,1] for each node. MUST have same length as nodes. Must not contain NaN or Infinity.

includeDescendants.description: If true, mask affects descendants of specified nodes. Descendants inherit the weight of their nearest listed ancestor unless explicitly listed with a different weight.
